AbortCampaign.description_en: Invoke AbortCampaign to stop the predictive outbound calling Activity corresponding to the specified Activity ID under the specified instance
AbortCampaign.description_zh: 调用AbortCampaign终止指定实例下指定活动ID对应的预测式外呼活动

AcceptChat.description_en: Call this operation to accept a chat
AcceptChat.description_zh: 调用AcceptChat接受指定实例下指定话务ID对应的聊天

AddBlacklistCallTagging.description_en: Adds a blacklist tag to a specified phone number. You can use this feature with your Interactive Voice Response (IVR) settings to block frequent harassing calls
AddBlacklistCallTagging.description_zh: 对指定号码添加黑名单标签，可结合IVR设置，防止其频繁呼入骚扰

AddCases.description_en: Invoke AddCases to add an outbound call list to a predictive dialing activity identified by a specified ID under a specified instance
AddCases.description_zh: 调用AddCases添加外呼名单到指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动

AddFeedback.description_en: You can use the AddFeedback API to evaluate and rate AI features
AddFeedback.description_zh: 使用AddFeedback接口对AI功能进行评价打分

AddNumbersToSkillGroup.description_en: Adds one or more phone numbers to a skill group by calling AddNumbersToSkillGroup
AddNumbersToSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用AddNumbersToSkillGroup添加一个或多个号码到同一个技能组下

AddPersonalNumbersToUser.description_en: You can invoke AddPersonalNumbersToUser to add one or more personal outbound numbers to a specified agent under a specified instance
AddPersonalNumbersToUser.description_zh: 调用AddPersonalNumbersToUser添加一个或多个个人外呼号码到指定实例下的指定坐席

AddPhoneNumberToSkillGroups.description_en: You can invoke AddPhoneNumberToSkillGroups to associate a phone number with one or more skill groups under a specified instance
AddPhoneNumberToSkillGroups.description_zh: 调用AddPhoneNumberToSkillGroups将号码关联到指定实例下的一个或多个技能组

AddPhoneNumbers.description_en: You can invoke AddPhoneNumbers to add one or more phone numbers to a specified instance
AddPhoneNumbers.description_zh: 调用AddPhoneNumbers添加一个或多个号码到指定实例下

AddSkillGroupsToUser.description_en: You can invoke AddSkillGroupsToUser to add one or more skill groups to a specified agent under a specified instance
AddSkillGroupsToUser.description_zh: 调用AddSkillGroupsToUser添加一个或多个技能组到指定实例下的指定坐席

AddTicketTask.description_en: Use AddTicketTask to add a signature and assign an assignee
AddTicketTask.description_zh: 使用AddTicketTask进行加签操作，添加处理人

AddUsersToSkillGroup.description_en: You can invoke AddUsersToSkillGroup to add one or more agents to the same skill group
AddUsersToSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用AddUsersToSkillGroup添加一个或多个坐席到同一个技能组

AnalyzeConversation.description_en: Analyze the specified text-based conversation content and extract summary-related information, such as the title, keywords, summary, and other specified details
AnalyzeConversation.description_zh: 分析指定的文字通话内容，提取摘要类相关信息，比如标题，关键词、小结以及其他指定的信息

AnswerCall.description_en: You can invoke AnswerCall to answer the call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance
AnswerCall.description_zh: 调用AnswerCall接听指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话

AppendCases.description_en: Adds cases to a predictive campaign in a specified instance
AppendCases.description_zh: 添加外呼名单到指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动

AssignUsers.description_en: Call AssignUsers to import one or more RAM users into a specified instance. After the import, the RAM users become agents in the instance
AssignUsers.description_zh: 调用AssignUsers将一个或多个RAM账户导入到指定实例中，成功导入后，RAM账户将以坐席的形式存在于实例中

BargeInCall.description_en: You can invoke BargeInCall to forcibly insert into an ongoing call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance. After the forced insertion succeeds, the original two-party call becomes a three-party conference call
BargeInCall.description_zh: 调用BargeInCall强行插入指定实例下指定通话ID对应的正在通话中的通话，强插成功后，通话将由原来的双方通话变成三人会议

BlindTransfer.description_en: Directly transfer a call to another agent, a skill group queue, or an external number. Direct transfer is also known as blind transfer or single-step transfer
BlindTransfer.description_zh: 直接转接通话到其他坐席或某个技能组队列或外部号码，直接转接也叫盲转或单步转

CancelAttendedTransfer.description_en: You can invoke the CancelAttendedTransfer API to cancel an attended transfer. You can call this API at any time after initiating the attended transfer and before completing it, even if the transferee has already answered the call
CancelAttendedTransfer.description_zh: 调用CancelAttendedTransfer取消咨询转接，在发起咨询转接后，完成咨询转接前，均可调用该接口取消咨询转接，即使被转接方已经接通，也可以取消

ChangeVisibility.description_en: Changes an agent's status to invisible. This is equivalent to the outbound-only mode
ChangeVisibility.description_zh: 修改隐身状态（等同于仅外呼场景）

ChangeWorkMode.description_en: You can invoke ChangeWorkMode to change the agent's work mode
ChangeWorkMode.description_zh: 调用ChangeWorkMode改变坐席的工作模式

ClaimCall.description_en: Call the `ClaimCall` API to assign a call to an agent
ClaimCall.description_zh: 调用接口ClaimCall把一个电话分配给一个坐席

ClaimChat.description_en: You can call ClaimChat to claim the chat for a specified Job ID in a specified instance
ClaimChat.description_zh: 调用ClaimChat认领指定实例下指定话务ID对应的聊天

CoachCall.description_en: You can invoke CoachCall to coach a specified agent in a specified call (identified by a call ID) under a specified instance. During the coaching session, the coached agent can hear the coach's voice, but the customer cannot hear the coach's voice
CoachCall.description_zh: 调用CoachCall辅导指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话中的指定坐席，辅导过程中被辅导坐席可以听到辅导者的声音，客户无法听到辅导者的声音

CompleteAttendedTransfer.description_en: You can invoke CompleteAttendedTransfer to complete a consultative transfer

CreateAudioFile.description_en: You can invoke CreateAudioFile to create an audio resource under a specified instance. The created audio resource can be used in the instance, such as selecting the audio file for playback during IVR
CreateAudioFile.description_zh: 调用CreateAudioFile在指定实例下创建一个音频资源，创建好的音频资源可以在实例中应用，比如在IVR放音时可以选择创建好的音频文件

CreateCallSummary.description_en: Use the CreateCallSummary operation to create a call summary

CreateCallTags.description_en: You can invoke CreateCallTags to create multiple call tags under a specified instance
CreateCallTags.description_zh: 调用CreateCallTags在指定实例下创建多个号码标签

CreateCampaign.description_en: You can invoke CreateCampaign to create a predictive outbound calling activity under a specified instance
CreateCampaign.description_zh: 调用CreateCampaign在指定实例下创建预测式外呼活动

CreateCustomCallTagging.description_en: You can invoke CreateCustomCallTagging to create one or more inbound number tags under a specified instance
CreateCustomCallTagging.description_zh: 调用CreateCustomCallTagging在指定实例下创建一个或多个呼入号码标记

CreateInstance.description_en: Invoke CreateInstance to create a Cloud Contact Center instance
CreateInstance.description_zh: 调用CreateInstance创建一个云联络中心实例

CreateSkillGroup.description_en: You can call CreateSkillGroup to create a skill group under a specified instance
CreateSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用CreateSkillGroup在指定实例下创建一个技能组

CreateTicket.description_en: Use CreateTicket to create a ticket

CreateUser.description_en: Call the CreateUser operation to create a new agent in a specified instance
CreateUser.description_zh: 调用CreateUser在指定实例下创建一个新的坐席

DeleteAudioFile.description_en: You can invoke DeleteAudioFile to delete the audio file associated with a specified audio resource ID under a specified instance
DeleteAudioFile.description_zh: 调用DeleteAudioFile删除指定实例下指定音频资源ID对应的音频文件

DeleteCallTag.description_en: You can invoke DeleteCallTag to delete a phone number tag under a specified instance
DeleteCallTag.description_zh: 调用DeleteCallTag删除指定实例下的号码标签

DeleteCustomCallTagging.description_en: You can invoke DeleteCustomCallTagging to delete the inbound number tag associated with a specified number under a specified instance
DeleteCustomCallTagging.description_zh: 调用DeleteCustomCallTagging删除指定实例下指定号码对应的呼入号码标记

DeleteSkillGroup.description_en: Invoke DeleteSkillGroup to delete the skill group associated with the specified skill group ID under the specified instance
DeleteSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用DeleteSkillGroup删除指定实例下指定技能组ID对应的技能组

DeleteTicketTemplate.description_zh: 使用DeleteTicketTemplate删除指定工单模板

DisableTicketTemplate.description_en: Use the DisableTicketTemplate operation to disable a ticket template. A disabled template cannot be selected when you create a new ticket
DisableTicketTemplate.description_zh: 使用DisableTicketTemplate进行工单模板的下线操作，下线状态的模板在新建工单时不能被选中

DiscardEditingContactFlow.description_en: Revoke contact flow editing and discard the associated draft
DiscardEditingContactFlow.description_zh: 撤销联系流编辑，丢弃对应草稿

EnableTicketTemplate.description_en: The EnableTicketTemplate operation publishes a ticket template. Published ticket templates can be used to create tickets
EnableTicketTemplate.description_zh: 使用EnableTicketTemplate上线工单模板，上线中状态的工单模板，可以用于创建工单

EndConference.description_en: You can invoke EndConference to make the specified agent exit the call associated with the specified call ID under the specified instance. The call must be in a conference state
EndConference.description_zh: 调用EndConference使指定坐席退出指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话，该通话必须处于会议状态

ExportCustomCallTagging.description_en: You can invoke ExportCustomCallTagging to export all inbound number tags under a specified instance
ExportCustomCallTagging.description_zh: 调用ExportCustomCallTagging导出指定实例下的全部呼入号码标记

ExportDoNotCallNumbers.description_en: The ExportDoNotCallNumbers operation exports a filtered list of do-not-call numbers from a specified instance
ExportDoNotCallNumbers.description_zh: 调用ExportDoNotCallNumbers导出指定实例下指定搜索条件过滤后的禁止外呼号码列表

FinishTicketTask.description_en: Use the FinishTicketTask operation to process tickets

GetAudioFile.description_en: Invoke GetAudioFile to obtain the audio file information corresponding to a specified audio resource ID under a specified instance
GetAudioFile.description_zh: 调用GetAudioFile获取指定实例下指定音频资源ID对应的音频文件信息

GetAudioFileDownloadUrl.description_en: Invoke GetAudioFileDownloadUrl to obtain the OSS download link for a specified audio resource under a specified instance
GetAudioFileDownloadUrl.description_zh: 调用GetAudioFileDownloadUrl获取指定实例下指定音频资源的OSS下载链接

GetAudioFileUploadParameters.description_en: Invoke the GetAudioFileUploadParameters API to obtain audio file upload parameters. Before creating an audio file, you must first call this API to retrieve the upload parameters and then call CreateAudioFile to create the audio file. This API is typically invoked by the default public cloud CRM system provided by Cloud Contact Center. It is not recommended for integration customers to call this API directly, because file upload must be performed through a Page operation first; only after the upload is complete can the GetAudioFileUploadParameters API be called
GetAudioFileUploadParameters.description_zh: 调用GetAudioFileUploadParameters获取音频文件上传参数，创建音频文件时，需要先调用该接口拿到上传参数，然后再调用CreateAudioFile创建音频文件。该接口通常由云联络中心提供的公有云默认CRM系统调用，不建议集成客户调用该接口，因为需要在页面上操作上传文件，上传完成后，才能调用GetAudioFileUploadParameters接口

GetCallDetailRecord.description_en: You can invoke the GetCallDetailRecord operation to retrieve call details for a specific call ID within a specific instance
GetCallDetailRecord.description_zh: 调用GetCallDetailRecord获取指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话的详情

GetCampaign.description_en: Gets a predictive outbound campaign by its ID from a specified instance
GetCampaign.description_zh: 调用GetCampaign获取指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动

GetCaseFileUploadUrl.description_en: Invoke GetCaseFileUploadUrl to obtain the OSS upload parameters for a predictive outbound calling list file under a specified instance. When creating a predictive outbound calling Activity by importing a file, you must first invoke this API to retrieve the file upload parameters and then invoke the CreateCampaign API
GetCaseFileUploadUrl.description_zh: 调用GetCaseFileUploadUrl获取指定实例下预测式外呼名单文件的OSS上传参数，当使用文件导入的方式创建预测式外呼活动时，需要先调用此接口拿到文件上传参数，然后再调用CreateCampaign接口

GetChatRoutingProfile.description_en: Use GetChatRoutingProfile to retrieve the chat routing configuration
GetChatRoutingProfile.description_zh: 使用GetChatRoutingProfile获取会话转接配置

GetConversationDetail.description_en: Call GetConversationDetail to obtain the conversation details for the call corresponding to the specified contact ID within the specified instance. The instance and skill group must have quality inspection push enabled to obtain these details
GetConversationDetail.description_zh: 调用GetConversationDetail获取指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话的对话详情，注意，实例及技能组需要开通质检推送才能获取到对话详情

GetDoNotCallFileUploadParameters.description_en: Invoke GetDoNotCallFileUploadParameters to obtain the upload parameters for a do-not-call file. When importing prohibited outbound call numbers through a file, you must first invoke this API to upload the do-not-call number file to the public OSS space of Cloud Contact Center, and then invoke ImportDoNotCallNumbers to execute the import
GetDoNotCallFileUploadParameters.description_zh: 调用GetDoNotCallFileUploadParameters获取禁呼文件的上传参数，当通过文件导入禁止外呼号码时，需要先调用此接口将禁呼号码文件上传到云联络中心的公共OSS空间，之后再调用ImportDoNotCallNumbers执行导入

GetEarlyMediaRecording.description_en: Retrieve early-media audio recordings for a call in a specified Cloud Contact Center instance
GetEarlyMediaRecording.description_zh: 获取指定实例下的通话早媒体音频

GetHistoricalCallerReport.description_en: Invoke GetHistoricalCallerReport to retrieve the historical inbound call report for a specified calling number under a specified instance
GetHistoricalCallerReport.description_zh: 调用GetHistoricalCallerReport获取指定实例下指定来电号码的历史呼入报表

GetHistoricalCampaignReport.description_en: You can invoke the GetHistoricalCampaignReport API to retrieve the historical data report of a predictive outbound calling activity corresponding to a specified ID under a specified instance
GetHistoricalCampaignReport.description_zh: 调用GetHistoricalCampaignReport接口获取指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动的历史数据报表

GetHistoricalInstanceReport.description_en: You can invoke GetHistoricalInstanceReport to obtain the historical data report for a specified instance
GetHistoricalInstanceReport.description_zh: 调用GetHistoricalInstanceReport获取指定实例的历史数据报表

GetInstance.description_en: Retrieves the details of a Cloud Contact Center instance
GetInstance.description_zh: 调用GetInstance获取指定实例ID所对应的云联络中心实例的详细信息

GetInstanceTrendingReport.description_en: You can call GetInstanceTrendingReport to retrieve the trend report for a specified instance
GetInstanceTrendingReport.description_zh: 调用GetInstanceTrendingReport获取指定实例的变化趋势报表

GetLoginDetails.description_en: Invoke GetLoginDetails to obtain the agent's logon information, including basic agent information, server address information, authentication information, and more. This API can only be invoked by the agent themselves; administrators are not permitted to invoke it on behalf of others
GetLoginDetails.description_zh: 调用GetLoginDetails获取坐席的登录信息，包括坐席基本信息、服务器地址信息、鉴权信息等，该接口只允许自己调用，管理员无权替他人调用

GetMonoRecording.description_en: You can invoke GetMonoRecording to obtain the single-track recording of a specified call under a specified instance. A single-track recording contains only one audio track, with both the agent-side and customer-side recordings merged into the same track in WAV format
GetMonoRecording.description_zh: 调用GetMonoRecording获取指定实例下指定通话的单轨录音，单轨录音只有一个音轨，坐席侧和客户侧的录音合并到了同一个音轨上，格式为WAV

GetMultiChannelRecording.description_en: You can invoke GetMultiChannelRecording to obtain the multi-track recording of a specified call under a specified instance. In the multi-track recording, the agent's and customer's audio are distributed across different sound channels. During each playback, only one sound channel can be played, meaning you can hear only one party's voice. The format is MKV
GetMultiChannelRecording.description_zh: 调用GetMultiChannelRecording获取指定实例下指定通话的多轨录音，多轨录音中坐席和客户的录音分布在不同的声道上，每次播放时只能单个声道播放，也就是只能听到其中一方的声音，格式为MKV

GetNumberLocation.description_en: Invoke the GetNumberLocation API to obtain number location information
GetNumberLocation.description_zh: 调用接口GetNumberLocation获取号码归属地信息

GetRealtimeCampaignStats.description_en: You can invoke GetRealtimeCampaignStats to retrieve real-time agent status data for a predictive outbound calling Activity with a specified ID under a specified instance
GetRealtimeCampaignStats.description_zh: 调用GetRealtimeCampaignStats获取指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动的实时坐席状态数据

GetRealtimeInstanceStates.description_en: You can invoke GetRealtimeInstanceStates to obtain the real-time status of a specified instance
GetRealtimeInstanceStates.description_zh: 调用GetRealtimeInstanceStates获取指定实例的实时状态

GetSkillGroup.description_en: You can invoke GetSkillGroup to obtain information about the skill group corresponding to a specified skill group ID under a specified instance
GetSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用GetSkillGroup获取指定实例下指定技能组ID对应的技能组的信息

GetSummaryTemplate.description_en: Retrieves the content of a session summary template
GetSummaryTemplate.description_zh: 使用GetSummaryTemplate获取会话小结模板内容

GetTicket.description_en: Retrieves information about a specific ticket
GetTicket.description_zh: 使用GetTicket获取指定工单信息

GetTicketSummaryReport.description_en: You can call GetTicketSummaryReport to retrieve a summary of ticket statuses
GetTicketSummaryReport.description_zh: 使用GetTicketSummaryReport获取工单状态统计数据

GetTicketTemplate.description_en: Call GetTicketTemplate to retrieve ticket template definitions
GetTicketTemplate.description_zh: 使用GetTicketTemplate获取工单模板定义信息

GetTurnCredentials.description_en: Call GetTurnCredentials to get the connection credentials for a Cloud Contact Center Point of Presence (PoP). These credentials include a username and password for authentication. Connecting to Cloud Contact Center through a PoP improves network quality and stability
GetTurnCredentials.description_zh: 调用GetTurnCredentials获取云联络中心前置接入点的连接凭证信息，主要包括鉴权需要用到的用户名和密码，通过前置接入点接入云联络中心可以有效提高网络质量和稳定性

GetTurnServerList.description_en: Call GetTurnServerList to get a list of front-end access points for Alibaba Cloud Contact Center. Connecting through these access points improves network quality and stability
GetTurnServerList.description_zh: 调用GetTurnServerList获取云联络中心的前置接入点列表，通过前置接入点接入云联络中心可以有效提高网络质量和网络稳定性

GetUploadAudioDataParams.description_en: Obtain the parameters related to offline quality inspection audio files. Normally, if the Customer has configured the quality inspection feature in Cloud Contact Center, the audio files requiring offline quality inspection and their corresponding parameters are automatically passed to Intelligent Quality Inspection. You only need to invoke this API to obtain the parameters for pushing quality inspection recordings when the Customer has not configured the quality inspection feature in Cloud Contact Center and wishes to manually push Cloud Contact Center call recordings to the quality inspection system
GetUploadAudioDataParams.description_zh: 获取离线质检音频文件相关参数。一般情况下，如果客户在云联络中心中配置了质检功能，则需要离线质检的音频文件和相应的参数会自动传递给智能质检；只有当客户没有在云联络中心中配置质检功能，并且希望自己把云联络中心的录音推送给质检时才需要调用此接口获取推送质检录音的相关参数

GetUser.description_en: You can invoke GetUser to obtain the agent information corresponding to a specified agent ID under a specified instance
GetUser.description_zh: 调用GetUser获取指定实例下指定坐席ID对应的坐席信息

GetVisitorLoginDetails.description_en: Call GetVisitorLoginDetails to retrieve login, server address, and authentication information for network service visitors
GetVisitorLoginDetails.description_zh: 调用GeVisitortLoginDetails获取网络业务访客的登录信息，服务器地址信息、鉴权信息等

GetVoicemailRecording.description_en: You can invoke GetVoicemailRecording to obtain the voicemail recording of a specified call under a specified instance. The recording is single-track and in WAV format
GetVoicemailRecording.description_zh: 调用GetVoicemailRecording获取指定实例下指定通话的语音信箱留言的录音，录音为单轨录音，格式为WAV

HoldCall.description_en: You can invoke HoldCall to hold the call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance. After the call is held, it will be temporarily suspended, and the held party will hear hold music
HoldCall.description_zh: 调用HoldCall保持指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话，通话被保持后，将暂时被挂起，此时被保持方会听到保持音乐

ImportAdmins.description_en: Imports one or more admins to a specified instance. The caller must have the `AliyunCCCFullAccess` permission, which you can grant in the RAM console
ImportAdmins.description_zh: 导入一个或多个管理员到指定实例下，调用者需要拥有AliyunCCCFullAccess的权限，可以在RAM控制台进行授权

ImportCorpNumbers.description_en: Imports your organization’s telephone line numbers. Before performing the first import, contact Cloud Contact Center technical support to add the numbers to the allowlist
ImportCorpNumbers.description_zh: 导入自有线路号码，首次导入前，需联系云联络中心-售后技术支持进行加白

ImportCustomCallTagging.description_en: You can invoke ImportCustomCallTagging to import multiple inbound number tags into a specified instance
ImportCustomCallTagging.description_zh: 调用ImportCustomCallTagging导入多个呼入号码标记到指定实例中

ImportDoNotCallNumbers.description_en: Imports one or more do-not-call numbers to a specified instance. You can import numbers by manual entry or file upload
ImportDoNotCallNumbers.description_zh: 调用ImportDoNotCallNumbers向指定实例下导入一个或多个禁止外呼号码，导入方式包括手动录入和文件上传两种方式

ImportRamUsers.description_en: Import existing RAM users as contact center agents
ImportRamUsers.description_zh: 将RAM中已存在的子账号导入为联络中心坐席

InitiateAttendedTransfer.description_en: Consultation transfer refers to transferring a call to another agent, a skill group queue, or an external number. It is also known as follow transfer or two-step transfer
InitiateAttendedTransfer.description_zh: 咨询转接通话到其他坐席或某个技能组队列或外部号码，咨询转接也叫关注转或双步转

InterceptCall.description_en: You can invoke InterceptCall to forcibly disconnect the call associated with a specified call ID under a given instance. The call must be in the listener state, and the forced disconnection must be initiated by the listener. After the forced disconnection succeeds, the agent who was originally talking with the customer will be disconnected, and the agent who initiated the forced disconnection will replace the original agent and continue the conversation with the customer
InterceptCall.description_zh: 调用InterceptCall强行拆开指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话，通话必须处于监听状态，且由监听者发起强拆，强拆成功后，原本与客户通话的坐席会被挂断，发起强拆的坐席代替原坐席继续与客户通话

LaunchAuthentication.description_en: You can invoke LaunchAuthentication to temporarily transfer a call into a specified IVR flow. After invoking this API, the call enters an IVR interaction phase, which is commonly used for identity verification operations
LaunchAuthentication.description_zh: 调用LaunchAuthentication使通话临时转入指定的IVR流程，调用此接口后，会在通话过程中进入IVR交互环节，通用用于核身操作

LaunchSurvey.description_en: Invoke LaunchSurvey to send a satisfaction survey. This operation causes the agent to hang up. If it is a voice-based satisfaction survey, the customer enters the IVR satisfaction survey flow after the agent hangs up and completes the satisfaction collection within the IVR flow. If it is an SMS-based satisfaction survey, the call ends and the customer receives a satisfaction survey text message
LaunchSurvey.description_zh: 调用LaunchSurvey发送满意度调查，该操作会导致挂机，如果是语音满意度，客户会在坐席挂机后进入IVR满意度调查流程，并在IVR流程中完成满意度采集。如果是短信满意度，则通话结束，客户收到满意度调查短信

ListAgentStateLogs.description_en: Invoke ListAgentStateLogs to obtain the status log list of a specified agent under a specified instance. Note that this API will soon expire. Use the override API ListRealtimeAgentStates instead
ListAgentStateLogs.description_zh: 调用ListAgentStateLogs获取指定实例下指定坐席的状态日志列表。注意本接口即将过期，请使用替代接口ListRealtimeAgentStates

ListAgentStates.description_en: You can invoke the ListAgentStates API to retrieve a list of agent statuses under a specified instance, filtered by specified conditions. This API is available only to specific Users. Other Customers are not recommended to invoke it
ListAgentStates.description_zh: 调用ListAgentStates获取指定实例下按指定条件过滤后的坐席状态列表，该接口仅对特定用户开放，其他客户不建议调用

ListAgentSummaryReportsSinceMidnight.description_en: You can invoke the ListAgentSummaryReportsSinceMidnight API to retrieve agent historical data reports under a specified instance, filtered by given conditions. The statistics cover data from 00:00 of the current day up to the current time. This API is available only to specific users; other customers are not recommended to invoke it
ListAgentSummaryReportsSinceMidnight.description_zh: 调用ListAgentSummaryReportsSinceMidnight获取指定实例下按指定条件过滤后的坐席历史数据报表，统计的是从当天0时开始，到当前时间为止的数据。该接口仅对特定用户开放，其他客户不建议调用

ListAttempts.description_en: You can invoke ListAttempts to obtain the list of contact dialing records for a specified predictive outbound calling Activity under a specified instance
ListAttempts.description_zh: 调用ListAttempts获取指定实例下指定预测式外呼活动的联系人拨打记录列表

ListAudioFiles.description_en: Invoke ListAudioFiles to obtain the list of audio files under a specified instance
ListAudioFiles.description_zh: 调用ListAudioFiles获取指定实例下的音频文件列表

ListBlacklistCallTaggings.description_en: Queries the blacklist tag status of specified numbers in a batch
ListBlacklistCallTaggings.description_zh: 批量查询指定号码黑名单打标状态

ListBriefSkillGroups.description_en: You can invoke ListBriefSkillGroups to obtain the list of skill group summary information under a specified instance
ListBriefSkillGroups.description_zh: 调用ListBriefSkillGroups获取指定实例下的技能组概要信息列表

ListCallDetailRecords.description_en: You can invoke ListCallDetailRecords to obtain a list of call details filtered by specified search conditions under a specified instance. This API is no longer iteratively updated. We recommend that you use the ListCallDetailRecordsV2 API instead
ListCallDetailRecords.description_zh: 调用ListCallDetailRecords获取指定实例下指定搜索条件过滤后的通话详情列表。接口不再迭代更新，建议优先使用ListCallDetailRecordsV2接口

ListCallDetailRecordsV2.description_en: Retrieves call details from a specified instance that match the search criteria
ListCallDetailRecordsV2.description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定搜索条件过滤后的通话详情列表

ListCallSummaries.description_en: Use the ListCallSummaries operation to retrieve call summaries
ListCallSummaries.description_zh: 使用ListCallSummaries接口获取会话小结

ListCallTags.description_en: You can invoke ListCallTags to obtain all number tags under a specified instance
ListCallTags.description_zh: 调用ListCallTags获取指定实例下的所有号码标签

ListCampaignTrendingReport.description_en: Obtain the trend report of the predictive outbound calling activity with the specified ID under the specified instance
ListCampaignTrendingReport.description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动的趋势报表

ListCampaigns.description_en: Calls ListCampaigns to obtain the list of predictive dialing campaigns under a specified instance
ListCampaigns.description_zh: 调用ListCampaigns获取指定实例下的预测式外呼活动列表

ListCases.description_en: Invoke ListCases to obtain the execution details list of the outbound contact list for the predictive dialing Activity corresponding to the specified ID under the specified instance
ListCases.description_zh: 调用ListCases获取指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动的外呼名单执行详情列表

ListCategories.description_en: You can use ListCategories to retrieve category information

ListCommonTicketFields.description_en: Retrieves the ticket field types that are defined for an instance
ListCommonTicketFields.description_zh: 使用ListCommonTicketFields获取实例下定义的工单字段类型

ListConfigItems.description_en: Retrieves the config items for a specified instance
ListConfigItems.description_zh: 调用ListConfigItems获取指定实例下的配置信息

ListContactFlows.description_en: Call ListContactFlows to retrieve the IVR contact flows for a specified instance
ListContactFlows.description_zh: 调用ListContactFlows获取指定实例下的IVR联系流列表

ListCustomCallTagging.description_en: You can invoke ListCustomCallTagging to obtain the list of inbound number marks under a specified instance
ListCustomCallTagging.description_zh: 调用ListCustomCallTagging获取指定实例下的呼入号码标记列表

ListDevices.description_en: Obtain the device list of a specified agent under a specified instance
ListDevices.description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定坐席的设备列表

ListDoNotCallNumbers.description_en: Retrieves the list of prohibited outbound call numbers under a specified instance, filtered by specified search conditions.
ListDoNotCallNumbers.description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定搜索条件过滤后的禁止外呼号码列表

ListFlashSmsApplications.description_en: You can use ListFlashSmsApplication to obtain third-party flash SMS configuration information
ListFlashSmsApplications.description_zh: 使用ListFlashSmsApplication获取第三方闪信配置信息

ListFlashSmsSettings.description_en: Call the ListFlashSmsSettings operation to retrieve the flash SMS configurations for a specified skill group
ListFlashSmsSettings.description_zh: 使用ListFlashSmsSettings接口获取指定技能组闪信相关配置

ListFlashSmsTemplates.description_en: Use ListFlashSmsTemplates to retrieve flash SMS template information
ListFlashSmsTemplates.description_zh: 使用ListFlashSmsTemplates获取闪信模板信息

ListGroupChatMessages.description_en: Retrieves the records of group chat messages

ListHistoricalAgentReport.description_en: Retrieves historical data reports for one or more agents in a specified instance
ListHistoricalAgentReport.description_zh: 调用ListHistoricalAgentReport获取指定实例下的一个或多个坐席的历史数据报表

ListHistoricalAgentSkillGroupReport.description_en: You can call ListHistoricalAgentSkillGroupReport to retrieve historical skill group reports for one or more agents in a specified instance
ListHistoricalAgentSkillGroupReport.description_zh: 调用ListHistoricalAgentSkillGroupReport获取指定实例下的一个或多个坐席的历史分组数据报表

ListHistoricalSkillGroupReport.description_en: You can invoke ListHistoricalSkillGroupReport to obtain historical data reports for one or more skill groups under a specified instance.
ListHistoricalSkillGroupReport.description_zh: 调用ListHistoricalSkillGroupReport获取指定实例下的一个或多个技能组的历史数据报表

ListInstances.description_en: Invoke the ListInstances API to obtain the list of Cloud Contact Center instances under the current Alibaba Cloud account
ListInstances.description_zh: 调用ListInstances获取当前阿里云账号下的云联络中心实例列表

ListInstancesOfUser.description_en: You can invoke ListInstancesOfUser to obtain the list of Cloud Contact Center instances to which the User belongs
ListInstancesOfUser.description_zh: 调用ListInstancesOfUser获取用户所属的云联络中心实例列表

ListIntervalAgentReport.description_en: You can invoke ListIntervalAgentReport to obtain the segment statistical report of a specified agent under a specified instance
ListIntervalAgentReport.description_zh: 调用ListIntervalAgentReport获取指定实例下指定坐席的分段统计报表

ListIntervalAgentSkillGroupReport.description_en: Retrieves the interval-based statistical report for a specified agent in a specified instance
ListIntervalAgentSkillGroupReport.description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定坐席的分段统计报表

ListIntervalInstanceReport.description_en: You can invoke ListIntervalInstanceReport to obtain the segment statistical report for a specified instance
ListIntervalInstanceReport.description_zh: 调用ListIntervalInstanceReport获取指定实例的分段统计报表

ListIntervalSkillGroupReport.description_en: You can invoke ListIntervalSkillGroupReport to obtain the segment-based statistical report of a specified skill group under a specified instance
ListIntervalSkillGroupReport.description_zh: 调用ListIntervalSkillGroupReport获取指定实例下指定技能组的分段统计报表

ListIvrTrackingDetails.description_en: Invoke ListIvrTrackingDetails to obtain the IVR tracking details of a specified call under a specified instance
ListIvrTrackingDetails.description_zh: 调用ListIvrTrackingDetails获取指定实例下指定通话的IVR轨迹详情

ListLegacyAgentEventLogs.description_en: You can invoke ListLegacyAgentEventLogs to obtain the list of 1.0 legacy agent event logs. This API is available only to specific Users, and other Customers are not recommended to invoke it
ListLegacyAgentEventLogs.description_zh: 调用ListLegacyAgentEventLogs获取1.0遗留坐席事件日志列表，该接口仅对特定用户开放，其他客户不建议调用

ListLegacyAgentStatusLogs.description_en: You can invoke ListLegacyAgentStatusLogs to obtain the list of legacy agent status logs for version 1.0. This API is available only to specific Users, and other Customers are not recommended to invoke it
ListLegacyAgentStatusLogs.description_zh: 调用ListLegacyAgentStatusLogs获取1.0遗留坐席状态日志列表，该接口仅对特定用户开放，其他客户不建议调用

ListLegacyQueueEventLogs.description_en: You can invoke ListLegacyQueueEventLogs to obtain the list of 1.0 legacy queue event logs. This API is available only to specific Users, and other Customers are not recommended to invoke it
ListLegacyQueueEventLogs.description_zh: 调用ListLegacyQueueEventLogs获取1.0遗留队列事件日志列表，该接口仅对特定用户开放，其他客户不建议调用

ListMonoRecordings.description_en: Call ListMonoRecordings to retrieve single-track recordings for each party in a specified call under a specified instance. During a call, each party has a channel, and each channel generates a combined track recording in WAV format
ListMonoRecordings.description_zh: 调用ListMonoRecordings获取指定实例下指定通话的各通话方的单轨录音，通话中每一方都有一个话务通道，每个话务通道对应生成一个合轨录音，格式为WAV

ListMultiChannelRecordings.description_en: Call ListMultiChannelRecordings to retrieve the multi-channel recordings for each party in a specified call and instance. Each party has a call channel that corresponds to a multi-channel recording in MKV format
ListMultiChannelRecordings.description_zh: 调用ListMultiChannelRecordings获取指定实例下指定通话的各通话方的多轨录音，通话中每一方都有一个话务通道，每个话务通道对应一个多轨录音，格式为MKV

ListNotificationRecords.description_en: Query notification records that were not sent using Message Queue (MQ)
ListNotificationRecords.description_zh: 查询非MQ方式消息推送记录

ListOutboundNumbersOfUser.description_en: `ListOutboundNumbersOfUser` retrieves the outbound numbers for a specified agent in a specified instance
ListOutboundNumbersOfUser.description_zh: 调用ListOutboundNumbersOfUser获取指定实例下指定坐席的可外呼号码

ListPersonalNumbersOfUser.description_en: You can invoke ListPersonalNumbersOfUser to obtain the list of personal outbound numbers for a specified agent under a specified instance. You can also use this API to retrieve the list of numbers that can be added as personal outbound numbers for an agent
ListPersonalNumbersOfUser.description_zh: 调用ListPersonalNumbersOfUser获取指定实例下指定坐席的个人外呼号码列表，也可通过该接口反查可添加为坐席个人外呼号码的号码列表

ListPhoneNumbers.description_en: You can invoke ListPhoneNumbers to obtain the phone number list under a specified instance
ListPhoneNumbers.description_zh: 调用ListPhoneNumbers获取指定实例下的号码列表

ListPhoneNumbersOfSkillGroup.description_en: You can invoke the ListPhoneNumbersOfSkillGroup API to obtain the list of phone numbers associated with a specified skill group under a specified instance. You can also use this API to query phone numbers that are not currently associated with the skill group but can be associated with it
ListPhoneNumbersOfSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用ListPhoneNumbersOfSkillGroup获取指定实例下指定技能组关联的号码列表，也可以通过该接口反查未关联但可关联到该技能组的号码

ListPrivilegesOfUser.description_en: Invoke ListPrivilegesOfUser to obtain the permissions owned by the current User
ListPrivilegesOfUser.description_zh: 调用ListPrivilegesOfUser获取当前用户拥有的权限

ListRamUsers.description_en: Lists RAM users that have not been imported into a specified instance
ListRamUsers.description_zh: 调用ListRamUsers获取未导入指定实例下的RAM用户列表

ListRealtimeAgentStates.description_en: You can invoke ListRealtimeAgentStates to obtain a real-time status data report for one or more specified agents in a specified instance
ListRealtimeAgentStates.description_zh: 调用ListRealtimeAgentStates获取指定实例下一个或多个指定坐席的实时状态数据报表

ListRealtimeSkillGroupStates.description_en: You can invoke ListRealtimeSkillGroupStates to obtain the real-time skill group status report for a specified instance
ListRealtimeSkillGroupStates.description_zh: 调用ListRealtimeSkillGroupStates获取指定实例下实时技能组状态报表

ListRecentCallDetailRecords.description_en: You can invoke ListRecentCallDetailRecords to obtain the list of recent call detail records for agents mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user under the specified instance
ListRecentCallDetailRecords.description_zh: 调用ListRecentCallDetailRecords获取指定实例下当前RAM账号映射的坐席的最近通话记录列表

ListRoles.description_en: You can invoke ListRoles to obtain all roles under a specified instance
ListRoles.description_zh: 调用ListRoles获取指定实例下的所有角色

ListSkillGroupStates.description_en: You can invoke the ListSkillgroupStates API to obtain the status list of specified skill groups under a specified instance. This API is only available to specific Users, and other Customers are not recommended to invoke it
ListSkillGroupStates.description_zh: 调用ListSkillgroupStates获取指定实例下指定技能组的状态列表，该接口仅对特定用户开放，其他客户不建议调用

ListSkillGroupSummaryReportsSinceMidnigh.description_en: The `ListSkillgroupSummaryReportsSinceMidnight` operation retrieves historical summary reports, filtered by specified conditions, for skill groups in a specified instance. The report contains data from 00:00 (midnight) today to the time of the request. This operation is available to specific users only
ListSkillGroupSummaryReportsSinceMidnigh.description_zh: 调用ListSkillgroupSummaryReportsSinceMidnight获取指定实例下按指定条件过滤后的技能组历史数据报表，统计的时间范围是从当天0时开始，到当前时间结束。该接口仅对特定用户开放，其他客户不建议调用

ListSkillGroups.description_en: You can invoke ListSkillGroups to obtain the list of skill groups under a specified instance
ListSkillGroups.description_zh: 调用ListSkillGroups获取指定实例下的技能组列表

ListSkillLevelsOfUser.description_en: You can use this API to retrieve the list of skill levels for skill groups associated with a specified agent under a specified instance. You can also use this API to query the list of skill groups that the agent can be associated with but is not currently associated with
ListSkillLevelsOfUser.description_zh: 获取指定实例下指定坐席关联的技能组的技能等级列表，也可以使用该接口查询坐席可关联但未关联的技能组列表

ListSmsMetadata.description_en: Queries the details of SMS configurations
ListSmsMetadata.description_zh: 使用ListSmsMetadata获取短信配置详情

ListTicketTemplates.description_en: Retrieves a list of ticket templates
ListTicketTemplates.description_zh: 使用ListTickerTemplate获取工单模板列表

ListTickets.description_en: Retrieves a list of tickets for an instance
ListTickets.description_zh: 使用ListTickets获取实例下工单列表

ListUnassignedNumbers.description_en: You can invoke ListUnassignedNumbers to obtain the list of numbers under your Alibaba Cloud account that have not been assigned to an instance
ListUnassignedNumbers.description_zh: 调用ListUnassignedNumbers获取阿里云主账号下未分配到实例的号码列表

ListUserLevelsOfSkillGroup.description_en: You can invoke the ListUserLevelsOfSkillGroup API to retrieve the list of agent skill levels under a specified skill group in a given instance. You can also use this API to retrieve the list of agents who can be associated with but are not currently associated with the specified skill group
ListUserLevelsOfSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用ListUserLevelsOfSkillGroup获取指定实例下指定技能组下属的坐席技能等级列表，也可以调用该接口反差可关联但未关联指定技能组的坐席列表

ListUsers.description_en: Invoke ListUsers to obtain the agent list under a specified instance
ListUsers.description_zh: 调用ListUsers获取指定实例下的坐席列表

ListVisitorChatMessages.description_en: You can use ListVisitorChatMessages to retrieve visitor chat records
ListVisitorChatMessages.description_zh: 使用ListVisitorChatMessages获取访客聊天记录

ListVoicemails.description_en: You can call the ListVoicemails operation to retrieve a list of voicemails for a specified instance
ListVoicemails.description_zh: 调用ListVoicemails获取指定实例下语音信箱列表

ListWaitingChats.description_en: The ListWaitingChats operation allows agents to retrieve chats that are waiting in a queue to be assigned or claimed
ListWaitingChats.description_zh: 坐席通过ListWaitingChats获取队列中等待分配或认领的聊天

MakeCall.description_en: You can invoke MakeCall to initiate a call. The callee can be an internal agent or an external customer
MakeCall.description_zh: 调用MakeCall发起呼叫，被叫可以是内部坐席，也可以是外部客户

ModifyAudioFile.description_en: You can invoke ModifyAudioFile to modify the audio file associated with a specified audio resource ID under a given instance. You can update the audio file name, display name, and the OSS key of the audio file
ModifyAudioFile.description_zh: 调用ModifyAudioFile修改指定实例下指定音频资源ID对应的音频文件。可以修改音频文件名称、音频文件展示名和音频文件在OSS中的Key

ModifyCampaignNumbers.description_en: Modifies the calling numbers for a batch prediction outbound campaign
ModifyCampaignNumbers.description_zh: 修改批量预测式外呼活动的主叫号码

ModifyCustomCallTagging.description_en: You can invoke ModifyCustomCallTagging to modify the description and attached number tags of an inbound number mark for a specified number under a specified instance
ModifyCustomCallTagging.description_zh: 调用ModifyCustomCallTagging修改指定实例下指定号码对应的呼入号码标记的信息，可以修改呼入号码标记的描述和绑定的号码标签

ModifyInstance.description_en: You can invoke ModifyInstance to modify a Cloud Contact Center instance
ModifyInstance.description_zh: 调用ModifyInstance修改云联络中心实例

ModifyPhoneNumber.description_en: You can invoke ModifyPhoneNumber to modify the information of a specified phone number under a specified instance, primarily to update the number's usage and the attached contact flow ID
ModifyPhoneNumber.description_zh: 调用ModifyPhoneNumber修改指定实例下指定号码的信息，主要是修改号码用途和绑定的联系流ID

ModifySkillGroup.description_en: You can invoke ModifySkillGroup to modify the information of a skill group associated with a specified skill group ID under a specified instance, primarily updating the skill group's display name and description
ModifySkillGroup.description_zh: 调用ModifySkillGroup修改指定实例下指定技能组ID对应的技能组的信息，主要是修改技能组展示名和技能组的描述信息

ModifySkillLevelsOfUser.description_en: Modify the skill level of a specified agent in one or more skill groups under a specified instance
ModifySkillLevelsOfUser.description_zh: 修改指定实例下指定坐席的一个或多个技能组下的技能等级

ModifyUser.description_en: You can invoke ModifyUser to modify the information of a specified agent under a specified instance. You can modify the phone number, work mode, role, and agent ID
ModifyUser.description_zh: 调用ModifyUser修改指定实例下指定坐席的信息，可修改电话号码、工作模式、角色和工号

ModifyUserLevelsOfSkillGroup.description_en: You can invoke ModifyUserLevelsOfSkillGroup to modify the skill levels of one or more agents under a specified skill group in a specified instance
ModifyUserLevelsOfSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用ModifyUserLevelsOfSkillGroup修改指定实例下指定技能组下属的一个或多个坐席的技能等级

MonitorCall.description_en: You can invoke MonitorCall to listen to a call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance. The call must be in a state where both the agent and the customer are normally connected, and the agent initiating the listening must have permission to monitor the target agent
MonitorCall.description_zh: 调用MonitorCall监听指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话。通话必须处于坐席和客户双方正常接通状态，且发起监听的坐席有权限对被监听坐席进行监听

MuteCall.description_en: You can invoke MuteCall to mute the call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance. This operation can only be invoked by an agent who is in a talking state, and the agent can only mute themselves. After the agent mutes themselves, the customer will no longer hear the agent's voice
MuteCall.description_zh: 调用MuteCall静音指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话，只能由正在通话状态的坐席调用，且只能静音调用者自己，坐席静音后，客户将无法听见坐席的声音

PauseCampaign.description_en: Invoke PauseCampaign to pause the predictive outbound calling Activity corresponding to the specified ID under the specified instance
PauseCampaign.description_zh: 调用PauseCampaign暂停指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动

PickOutboundNumbers.description_en: You can invoke PickOutboundNumbers to select an appropriate caller number based on the provided callee number. The number selection logic is controlled by an Intelligent algorithm
PickOutboundNumbers.description_zh: 调用PickOutboundNumbers根据传入的被叫号码选择适合的主叫号码，选号逻辑由智能算法控制

PollUserStatus.description_en: Polls the agent status of a specified agent under a specified instance. This operation is typically invoked by the frontend agent Workbench to synchronize agent status
PollUserStatus.description_zh: 轮询指定实例下指定坐席的坐席状态，一般由前端坐席工作台调用，用于同步坐席状态

ReadyForService.description_en: You can invoke ReadyForService to make a specified agent under a specified instance ready. After becoming ready, the agent enters the idle status
ReadyForService.description_zh: 调用ReadyForService使指定实例下的指定坐席就绪，就绪后坐席进入空闲状态

RedialCall.description_en: Redial the number in the desensitized call record
RedialCall.description_zh: 重拨脱敏后的话单中的号码

RegisterDevice.description_en: Registers a Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) device with a specified agent in an instance. A SIP device can be a physical SIP phone or a softphone
RegisterDevice.description_zh: 调用RegisterDevice注册SIP设备到指定实例下的指定坐席， SIP设备可以是SIP话机或SIP软电话

RegisterDevices.description_en: Registers one or more SIP devices to specified agents in an instance. A SIP device can be a SIP phone or a SIP softphone
RegisterDevices.description_zh: 调用RegisterDevices注册一个或多个SIP设备到指定实例下的指定坐席，SIP设备可以是SIP话机或SIP软电话

RejectChat.description_en: Rejects a chat assigned to an agent
RejectChat.description_zh: 坐席通过RejectChat拒绝接受被分配的聊天

RejectTicket.description_en: Use the RejectTicket operation to reject a ticket. The ticket creator can add information to a rejected ticket and then resubmit it
RejectTicket.description_zh: 使用RejectTicket退回工单，退回的工单在创建人补充信息后可以重新提交

ReleaseCall.description_en: You can invoke ReleaseCall to hang up the call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance. The invoker must be an agent and currently in a call
ReleaseCall.description_zh: 调用ReleaseCall挂断指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话，调用者必须是坐席，且正处于通话状态

ReleaseChat.description_en: The ReleaseChat operation ends the current chat
ReleaseChat.description_zh: 通话ReleaseChat接口结束当前聊天

RemoveBlacklistCallTagging.description_en: Removes the blacklist tag from a specified phone number
RemoveBlacklistCallTagging.description_zh: 移除指定号码的黑名单标签

RemoveDoNotCallNumbers.description_en: You can invoke RemoveDoNotCallNumbers to delete one or more Do Not Call number configuration items under a specified instance
RemoveDoNotCallNumbers.description_zh: 调用RemoveDoNotCallNumbers删除指定实例下的一个或多个禁止外呼号码配置项

RemovePersonalNumbersFromUser.description_en: You can invoke RemovePersonalNumbersFromUser to delete one or more personal outbound numbers associated with a specified agent under a specified instance
RemovePersonalNumbersFromUser.description_zh: 调用RemovePersonalNumbersFromUser删除指定实例下指定坐席的一个或多个个人外呼号码

RemovePhoneNumberFromSkillGroups.description_en: You can invoke RemovePhoneNumberFromSkillGroups to delete the binding relationship between a specified phone number and one or more skill groups under a given instance. This operation removes only the association between the phone number and the skill groups, not the actual phone number itself
RemovePhoneNumberFromSkillGroups.description_zh: 调用RemovePhoneNumberFromSkillGroups删除指定实例下指定号码关联的一个或多个技能组与该号码的绑定关系，删除的是号码与技能组的绑定关系，并不是真实号码

RemovePhoneNumbers.description_en: Removes one or more numbers from an instance. This action disassociates the numbers from the instance but does not permanently delete them. It also disassociates all associated resources, such as skill groups, contact flows, and agents
RemovePhoneNumbers.description_zh: 调用RemovePhoneNumbers删除指定实例下的一个或多个号码。并非真实删除某个号码，而是将这个号码与实例进行解绑，包括号码关联的技能组、联系流、坐席等，都将随之解绑

RemovePhoneNumbersFromSkillGroup.description_en: You can invoke RemovePhoneNumbersFromSkillGroup to delete the association between one or more phone numbers and a specified skill group under a given instance
RemovePhoneNumbersFromSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用RemovePhoneNumbersFromSkillGroup删除指定实例下指定技能组关联的一个或多个号码与该技能组的关联关系

RemoveSkillGroupsFromUser.description_en: You can invoke RemoveSkillGroupsFromUser to delete the association between one or more skill groups and a specified agent under a specified instance
RemoveSkillGroupsFromUser.description_zh: 调用RemoveSkillGroupsFromUser删除指定实例下指定坐席关联的一个或多个技能组与该坐席之间的关联关系

RemoveUsers.description_en: You can invoke RemoveUsers to delete one or more agents from a specified instance. This operation only detaches the RAM accounts from the instance and removes the agents mapped to those RAM accounts from the instance. It does not delete the RAM accounts themselves
RemoveUsers.description_zh: 调用RemoveUsers删除指定实例下的一个或多个坐席，该操作仅将RAM账户与实例解绑，然后将RAM账户映射的坐席从实例中删除，并不会删除RAM账户本身

RemoveUsersFromSkillGroup.description_en: You can invoke RemoveUsersFromSkillGroup to delete the association between one or more agents and a specified skill group under a specified instance. This operation only removes the association between the skill group and the agents and does not delete the agents themselves
RemoveUsersFromSkillGroup.description_zh: 调用RemoveUsersFromSkillGroup删除指定实例下指定技能组关联的一个或多个坐席，该操作仅删除技能组与坐席之间的关联关系，并不会删除坐席

ResetAgentState.description_en: Resets the state of a specific agent in a specific instance
ResetAgentState.description_zh: 调用ResetAgentState重置指定实例下指定坐席的坐席状态

ResetUserPassword.description_en: Invoke ResetUserPassword to reset the logon password of a specified agent under a specified instance. In practice, agents do not have logon passwords; this operation actually modifies the logon password of the RAM account associated with the agent. This is typically used in scenarios where a customer service representative forgets the logon password of their RAM account
ResetUserPassword.description_zh: 调用ResetUserPassword重置指定实例下指定坐席的登录密码。实际上坐席并没有登录密码，修改的是坐席关联的RAM账户的登录密码，通常用于客服忘记自己的RAM账户登录密码的场景

RestoreArchivedRecordings.description_en: Restores call recordings for the specified instance
RestoreArchivedRecordings.description_zh: 解冻指定实例下的通话录音

ResubmitTicket.description_en: You can use the ResubmitTicket API to resubmit a rejected or returned ticket
ResubmitTicket.description_zh: 使用ResubmitTicket接口对驳回/退回的工单重新提交

ResumeCampaign.description_en: Invoke ResumeCampaign to recover the predictive outbound calling Activity corresponding to the specified ID under the specified instance
ResumeCampaign.description_zh: 调用ResumeCampaign恢复指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动

RetrieveCall.description_en: You can invoke RetrieveCall to retrieve a call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance. The call must be on hold for the retrieve operation to be performed
RetrieveCall.description_zh: 调用RetrieveCall取回指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话，通话必须处于保持状态才可操作取回

SaveRTCStatsV2.description_en: Invoke SaveRTCStatsV2 to report Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC) voice transmission statistics information from the agent side. This API is not relevant for regular customers
SaveRTCStatsV2.description_zh: 调用SaveRTCStatsV2上报坐席端WebRTC语音传输统计信息，普通客户无需关心该接口

SaveTerminalLog.description_en: Invoke the SaveTerminalLog API to report agent-side log information. Regular customers do not need to be concerned with this API
SaveTerminalLog.description_zh: 调用SaveTerminalLog上报坐席端日志信息，普通客户无需关心该接口

SaveWebRTCStats.description_en: Invoke the SaveWebRTCStats API to report Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC) voice transmission statistics information from the agent side. Regular customers do not need to concern themselves with this API
SaveWebRTCStats.description_zh: 调用SaveWebRTCStats上报坐席端WebRTC语音传输统计信息，普通客户无需关心该接口

SaveWebRtcInfo.description_en: Invoke the SaveWebRtcInfo API to report WebRTC call status information from the agent side, including call quality monitoring data, for backend statistics and monitoring. Customers do not need to concern themselves with this API
SaveWebRtcInfo.description_zh: 调用SaveWebRtcInfo上报座席端WebRTC的通话状态信息，包括通话质量监控数据等，用于后台统计和监控，客户无需关心该接口

SendDtmfSignaling.description_en: You can invoke SendDtmfSignaling to send DTMF keypress information during a call
SendDtmfSignaling.description_zh: 调用SendDtmfSignaling在通话过程中发送DTMF按键信息

SignInGroup.description_en: You can invoke SignInGroup to sign an agent into a specified skill group under a specified instance, which is the operation for publishing the agent online
SignInGroup.description_zh: 调用SignInGroup使坐席签入指定实例下的指定技能组，即坐席上线操作

SignOutGroup.description_en: You can call SignOutGroup to check out an agent from the skill group they are currently signed into, which is equivalent to performing an unpublish operation for the agent
SignOutGroup.description_zh: 调用SignOutGroup使坐席签出当前签入的技能组，即坐席下线操作

StartBack2BackCall.description_en: You can invoke StartBack2BackCall to initiate a back-to-back call

StartConference.description_en: You can invoke StartConference to initiate a conference

StartEditContactFlow.description_en: Start editing a contact flow and generate a draft version
StartEditContactFlow.description_zh: 发起编辑联系流，生成联系流草稿

StartPredictiveCall.description_en: Invoke StartPredictiveCall to initiate predictive outbound calling

SubmitCampaign.description_en: Invoke SubmitCampaign to start the predictive outbound calling activity corresponding to the specified ID under the specified instance
SubmitCampaign.description_zh: 调用SubmitCampaign启动指定实例下指定ID对应的预测式外呼活动

SwitchToConference.description_en: You can invoke SwitchToConference to switch the status of a specified call under a specified instance to a three-party conference. This is typically used in scenarios where a consultation is converted into a conference
SwitchToConference.description_zh: 调用SwitchToConference将指定实例下的指定通话的状态切换至三方会议，通常用于咨询转会议的场景

TakeBreak.description_en: You can invoke TakeBreak to set a specified agent in a specified instance to the break state
TakeBreak.description_zh: 调用TakeBreak将指定实例下的指定坐席设置为小休状态

TransferTicketTask.description_en: You can call TransferTicketTask to transfer a ticket to another user
TransferTicketTask.description_zh: 使用TransferTicketTask指派工单给其他处理人处理

UnregisterDevice.description_en: You can invoke UnregisterDevice to delete the device registration record of a specified agent under a specified instance. After deletion, the SIP phone or SIP softphone associated with the agent becomes inactive
UnregisterDevice.description_zh: 调用UnregisterDevice删除指定实例下指定坐席的设备注册记录，删除后将导致与坐席关联的SIP话机或SIP软电话不可用

UpdateChatRoutingProfile.description_en: You can use UpdateChatRoutingProfile to configure session transfers
UpdateChatRoutingProfile.description_zh: 使用UpdateChatRoutingProfile进行会话转接配置

UpdateConfigItems.description_en: Use the UpdateConfigItems operation to add or modify configuration items for an instance, such as hiding the caller ID for inbound calls or allowing agents to hang up
UpdateConfigItems.description_zh: 调用UpdateConfigItems添加或修改指定实例下的配置信息，例如：来电显示是否隐藏号码，呼入场景下是否允许坐席主动挂机等

UpdateSubscription.description_en: Use the UpdateSubscription operation to configure message subscriptions
UpdateSubscription.description_zh: 使用UpdateSubscription接口进行消息订阅配置

UpdateTicket.description_en: UpdateTicket updates the content of a ticket

WithdrawTicket.description_en: You can use WithdrawTicket to withdraw a ticket
